query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS molecule_origins (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  molecule_id INT NOT NULL,
  origin_id INT NOT NULL,
  is_primary_origin TINYINT DEFAULT 0,
  quality_rating INT,
  production_volume VARCHAR(100),
  price_range VARCHAR(100),
  specific_characteristics TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_molecule_origin (molecule_id, origin_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (molecule_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (origin_id) REFERENCES geographic_origins(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
